person.name: Ishank Bahl
person.headline: Senior Software Engineer and Tech Lead
person.positioning: Seven years building product end to end, from micro-frontends and design systems to the APIs, data models and infrastructure underneath.

intro: I work on the parts of a system other teams depend on. That has meant a hierarchical configuration model and a React micro-frontend that had to live inside an Angular host, the home and discovery surfaces of a streaming product, and the feature flag SDK that server side experiments call. I write the services and data models behind those interfaces too, in Node, Python and SQL, and I have owned the infrastructure they run on. The work is the contract underneath the screen rather than the screen: what a team can change safely, what breaks when they do, and who finds out.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead
lines: Architected a hierarchical configuration system and integrated a React micro-frontend into an Angular host application.
Built an LLM powered Slack assistant that automated on-call triage and patch workflows.
Built and integrated backend APIs across Node.js, Python, PHP, Java and SQL.
Owned infrastructure projects end to end and mentored the developers on them.
